University · Islamic University

Islamic University of Gaza

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
University Gaza Operational

Founded in 1978, the Islamic University of Gaza (IUG) was Gaza's largest and most prominent higher education institution. It offered programmes across engineering, medicine, arts, sciences, and Islamic studies, and housed internationally recognised research centres. The university was presided over by physicist Dr. Sufyan Tayeh, who was killed in December 2023.

📅 2023-11-10 Airstrike INC-037
More strikes on the Islamic University of Gaza campus

Israel extensively bombs the Gaza campus of the Islamic University of Gaza, destroying its mosque and most of its main buildings (University of Chicago). On its official Facebook page, the university announced that the Information Technology Faculty building, the Faculty of Social Affairs and Continuing Education building, and the Science Faculty building all suffered severe damage, along with their equipment, laboratories, and furniture. All the windows in all the university buildings and on their facades are shattered (Palestine Studies).

📅 14/09/2025 14:30 Direct Strike INC-041
one or more buildings within the Islamic University were successively hit

On 14 September, at about 14:30, at least seven Palestinians were reportedly killed, and others were reported missing under the rubble, when one or more buildings within the Islamic University were successively hit in Ar Rimal neighbourhood, in central Gaza city, after the Israeli military reportedly issued warnings for people in the area to evacuate. At least one building was sheltering IDPs, who reportedly returned to collect belongings after the second strike when the building was struck again with high-explosive missiles.

📅 14/09/2025 Airstrike INC-040
The university of was hit again while the IDF was targeting high rises in Gaza City

Another building at the Islamic University in Gaza was struck and destroyed by several missiles, according to images and video from the scene. Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz posted a video of the strikes targeting the six-story building on X, saying: “The ‘Islamic’ University in Gaza is going up in smoke. Eliminating the sources of incitement and terrorism.”
